name: NØRR3 — Marketing Engine
description: NØRR3 Marketing Engine is a multi-location marketing automation platform. Chains and multi-location businesses define a campaign once; the Engine generates every location's own campaign — creatives, copy, budget and schedule — from a single feed, then reports performance per location. Managed as a service by NØRR3, a Nordic insight and media agency in Helsinki.
capabilities: Creative automation across formats (Meta, Display, DOOH)
Audience and media research (NØRR3 Media Insights)
